name: Murasaki Shikibu
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 57); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 992.

poems.title: I wandered forth this moonlight night
poems.author: Murasaki Shikibu
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 57
poems.text:
I wandered forth this moonlight night,
And some one hurried by;
But who it was I could not see,—
Clouds driving o’er the sky
Obscured the moon on high.
